content.title: What's open, closed on Easter? See hours for restaurants, stores, more
content.text: April 4, 2026, 3:01 p.m. ETEaster is here, and whether you're looking to do some last-minute shopping or grab a bite to eat, consumers will have plenty of options to choose from on Sunday.Many national retailers, grocery stores and restaurant chains will be open on Easter Sunday, albeit some with reduced hours. A few companies, like Costco, Target, and Macy's, will be closed. Banks, post offices, and shipping services will also largely be closed on Easter.This year, Easter falls on Sunday, April 5. The date the holiday is celebrated depends on the year because it is one of several "moveable feasts" in the liturgical year, according to the History Channel.Other examples include Ash Wednesday and Palm Sunday. The holiday is an important one for millions of people around the world who follow the Christian faith, as it celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ after a 40-day period known as Lent.When is Easter 2026?This year, Easter falls on Sunday, April 5.Is Walmart open on Easter?Yes, Walmart stores will be open regular hours on Easter, according to the company's website. Most Walmart stores are open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily.Is Target open on Easter?No, Target stores will be closed on Easter Sunday this year, the company confirmed to USA TODAY.Are Costco, Sam's Club, or BJ's Wholesale open on Easter?Costco and Sam's Club warehouses will both be closed on April 5, according to each company's website. BJ's warehouses will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Sunday, per the company's website.Are CVS and Walgreens open on Easter?CVS locations will be open on Easter, although some locations may have reduced hours. Customers are encouraged to call their local store before visiting or checking hours online at CVS.com.Walgreens stores and pharmacies will be open regular hours on Easter, the company told USA TODAY.Are Home Depot, Lowe's or Ace Hardware open on Easter?Home Depot stores will be open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Sunday, April 5, the company confirmed to USA TODAY, while Lowe's stores will be closed.While most Ace Hardware stores are expected to remain open on Easter, stores are independently owned and operated, with locations' hours varying. Customers are encouraged to contact their local store to confirm business hours on Easter.Are banks, post offices, UPS and FedEx open on Easter?U.S. Postal Service facilities will be closed for retail transactions and there will be no regular residential or business mail deliveries on Sunday, April 5. Priority Mail Express is delivered 365 days a year, including Sundays.UPS and FedEx pickup and delivery services will not be available on Easter. UPS Store locations may be closed, according the company's website, and FedEx Office hours will also be modified.Since Easter falls on a Sunday, banks that typically close on Sundays will also be closed on Easter Sunday.Restaurants open on Easter 2026The following restaurants are open on April 5.McDonald'sStarbucksDunkin'Burger KingCracker BarrelWendy'sFreddy's Frozen Custard & SteakburgersShake ShackGolden CorralOlive GardenLonghorn SteakhouseApplebee'sIHOPWaffle HouseKFCSubwayTaco BellBonefish GrillFirehouse SubsCheesecake FactoryPanera BreadKrispy KremeWhataburgerLonghorn SteakhouseFirst WatchThe following restaurants are closed on April 5.Chick-fil-AChipotleRaising Cane'sGrocery stores open on Easter 2026The following grocery stores are open on Easter.
